attchmntText: Talbros Automotive Components Limited has informed the Exchange about change in address of the Corporate Office of Registrar to an Issue and Share Transfer Agent (RTA) of the Company.
voiceSummary: Talbros Automotive Components Limited has intimated that its Registrar to an Issue and Share Transfer Agent, KFin Technologies Limited, is shifting its Corporate Office effective from December 01, 2026. The new Corporate Office address is 6, 23, 24, 25th Floor, South Tower, Rajapushpa West Avenue, survey No. 115, Kokapet, Serilingampally Mandal, Ranga Reddy District, Telangana, 500075. Contact details include telephone number 081210 13657 and email statutoryandcompliance@kfintech.com. The previous Corporate Office was located at Selenium Tower B, Plot No. 31 and 32, Gachibowli, Financial District, Nanakramguda, Serilingampally, Hyderabad, 500032, Telangana. The Registered Office of the RTA at 301, The Centrium, 3rd Floor, 57, Lal Bahadur Shastri Road, Nav Pada, Kurla (West), Mumbai, Maharashtra, 400070 remains unchanged. All future correspondence should be addressed to the new location.

attchmntText: Talbros Automotive Components Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Audio Recording for Q2 & H1 FY27 Earnings Conference Call
voiceSummary: Talbros Automotive Components Limited has released the audio recording of the Q2 and H1 FY27 Earnings Conference Call held on 12th November 2026. The call discussed the operational and financial performance for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. The recording is available on the company website. This disclosure is made pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations 2015. The announcement was issued by Seema Narang, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Talbros Automotive Components Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of extract of Unaudited Financial Results for the 2nd Quarter and Half Year ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Talbros Automotive Components Limited submitted the newspaper publication of extracts of its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026 to the BSE and NSE. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and approved by the Board of Directors on 11th November 2026. Consolidated net profit after tax was Rs. 3294.44 lacs for the quarter and Rs. 6295.04 lacs for the half year. Standalone net profit after tax was Rs. 2777.65 lacs for the quarter and Rs. 5169.86 lacs for the half year. CESC Limited invited e-tenders for the purchase of Round The Clock and Non-Round The Clock power on a short-term basis from 1st April 2027 to 30th June 2027. Lark Trading and Finance Limited announced an Extra Ordinary General Meeting scheduled for 4th December 2026. Remote e-voting for the meeting is available from 1st December 2026 to 3rd December 2026. The Government of Meghalaya extended the deadline for CMJ University students to submit examination details to 14th December 2026. The Debt Recovery Tribunal Delhi issued a demand notice against Jai Hanuman Readymade Agency for Rs. 5368929.42 plus interest.

attchmntText: Talbros Automotive Components Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Talbros Automotive Components Limited filed its Q2 and H1 FY27 investor presentation with the BSE and NSE on 11th November 2026. The company reported consolidated total income of Rs. 510 crores for H1 FY27, a 19 percent year-on-year increase. Profit after tax stood at Rs. 63 crores, up 39 percent. The group secured new orders worth over Rs. 1,000 crores, to be executed over five years starting FY27. This includes Rs. 250 crores in gaskets and heat shields, Rs. 500 crores in forgings, Rs. 90 crores in chassis components, and Rs. 170 crores in rubber products. Approximately Rs. 700 crores of these orders are for exports. The company highlighted its expanding footprint in Europe and increased EV segment sales.

attchmntText: Talbros Automotive Components Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 11, 2026, titled "Press Release for Q2 & H1 FY27 Financial and Business Updatae ".
voiceSummary: Talbros Automotive Components Limited announced unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. Total income from operations for Q2 FY27 reached Rs. 267 crores, representing a 23% year-on-year growth. EBITDA stood at Rs. 47 crores, up 33% year-on-year, with margins expanding to 17.6%. Profit after tax was Rs. 33 crores, a 43% increase year-on-year. For the half year, total revenue was Rs. 509.7 crores, up 19% year-on-year. Exports contributed 28% of income from operations in Q2 FY27. The company secured new orders worth over Rs. 1,000 crores for execution over the next five years.

attchmntText: Talbros Automotive Components Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Dividend  is 20-Nov-2026.
voiceSummary: Talbros Automotive Components Limited approved the Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30 September 2026. The Board declared an Interim Dividend at the rate of 15 percent, equating to Rs.0.30 per equity share of face value Rs. 2. The record date for dividend entitlement is 20 November 2026. Standalone net profit for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 was Rs. 27,77,65,000. Standalone revenue from operations for the same quarter was Rs. 26,32,08,000. Earnings per share stood at Rs. 4.50. The Board meeting occurred on 11 November 2026.
